There's an asteroid made of metal worth $10,000 quadrillion — and NASA already sent a spaceship to it.

It's called 16 Psyche, an asteroid made mostly of metal. Its lead scientist once put its value at $10,000 quadrillion — then called the number meaningless. NASA's Psyche spacecraft launched in 2023 and arrives in 2029.

Sources: NASA, Arizona State University. 3D animation.

#space #nasa #asteroid #gold #future
tt_title: The asteroid worth more than Earth
yt_desc:
16 Psyche is a metal-rich asteroid in the main belt. Mission lead Lindy Elkins-Tanton once estimated the value of its metal at $10,000 quadrillion — and has called the figure meaningless, since that much metal would crash prices. NASA's Psyche spacecraft launched in October 2023 and is due to arrive in 2029.

Sources:
- NASA Psyche mission pages (science.nasa.gov/mission/psyche)
- Arizona State University Psyche mission
